# TC.Config.SectionFilter

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.SectionFilter"></a>

### TC.Config.SectionFilter

Indexed native section filter. Dense array with unique slot indexes and effective identities. Default minimum 0; current adapter defaults item import_from to registered nauvis when available. Maximum cannot be below minimum. Nonzero object-filter minimum requires explicit exact quality. Section filters additionally require index and reject duplicate slots/effective identities. Unknown fields refused. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

### import_from (optional)

Installed import location; current adapter defaults item imports to registered nauvis when available. At most 256 bytes; no NUL. Installed space_location name, never a native object. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
string
```

### index

Explicit native filter slot index; sparse slots allowed in a dense unique-index array. Finite integer; domain 1..128. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
integer
```

### max (optional)

Maximum requested count, not below a supplied minimum. Finite integer; domain 0..4294967295. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.ItemCountType
```

### min (optional)

Minimum requested count; defaults zero. Nonzero filtered counts require exact quality. Finite integer; domain -2147483648..2147483647. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
integer
```

### minimum_delivery_count (optional)

Minimum native delivery quantity for this filter. Finite integer; domain 0..4294967295. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.ItemCountType
```

### value (optional)

Signal filter; absent value means an empty slot, not a numeric zero signal. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
TC.Config.SignalFilter
```
